The '''Cularin space slug''' was a variety of [[Exogorth/Legends|space slug]]&mdash;gigantic [[Silicon/Legends|silicon]]-based lifeforms that live in the [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] of [[Realspace/Legends|space]]&mdash;found in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. Cularin space slugs were more docile than the space slugs found elsewhere in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and could be trained as guards. It was speculated that they descended from domesticated creatures on the Cularin system [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Oblis]], a world that's [[Destruction of Oblis|destruction]] formed the [[Cularin asteroid belt]].

==Biology and appearance==
The Cularin space slug was a variety of [[Exogorth/Legends|space slug]], colossal, [[Worm/Legends|wormlike]] [[Silicon/Legends|silicon]]-based lifeforms that resided in [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. They could grow up to 900 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length and were large enough to engorge whole [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. The inside of a Cularin space slug's [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]] contained a pressurised [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] in which other creatures could survive with the assistance of a [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]].<ref name="Cularin Space Slug" />

The slugs were long-lived and were believed to have lifespans of tens of thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. Their metabolic rate was also slow and the slugs were capable of digesting and fully consuming both organic and inorganic substances over the course of tens of thousands of years. They [[Reproduction/Legends|reproduced]] via fission, whereby a slug that grew sufficiently large would divide into two independent smaller creatures.<ref name="Cularin Space Slug" />

==Behavior==
Cularin space slugs could be found on large [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]], where they resided in [[Cave/Legends|caves]] and hollows. They fed on [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]] and it was possible for a group of the slugs to strip an asteroid of all its mineral resources.<ref name="Cularin Space Slug" />

A unique trait that distinguished Cularin space slugs from other varieties of space slug was their docility. The slugs were receptive to instruction and could easily be seasoned to undertake basic tasks.<ref name="Cularin Space Slug" />

==History==
Found in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]],<ref name="Cularin Space Slug" /> in the [[Thaere sector]],<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> Cularin space slugs were present in the [[Star system/Legends|star system's]] [[Cularin asteroid belt|asteroid belt]]. Due to their pliant nature, it was speculated that Cularin space slugs were descended from domesticated creatures. It was also believed that they possibly originated from [[Oblis]], a [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Destruction of Oblis|destroyed]]<ref name="Cularin Space Slug" /> by the [[Darkstaff]] [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] many years before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="Recursion">{{LivingForce|Belted In: Recursion}}</ref> the remains of which formed the Cularin asteroid field. According to this theory, following Oblis's destruction, the slugs' ancestors endured and adjusted to life in the [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] of space.<ref name="Cularin Space Slug" />

==Cularin space slugs in the galaxy==
[[Smuggler/Legends|Smugglers]] based in the Cularin asteroid belt were known to utilize tamed Cularin space slugs as guards. Some such smugglers professed to be able to dock their starships inside the mouths of their slugs to evade passing military vessels. The [[Captain/Legends|captains]] of space [[Transport/Legends|transports]] often tried to avoid Cularin space slugs out of fear that [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] could lie in wait inside the slugs' mouths to ambush passing [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]], though most Cularin system government sources denied that pirates followed this practice.<ref name="Cularin Space Slug" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cularin space slugs were mentioned in the article ''Creature Feature: Cularin Space Slug'', which was written by [[Jeff Quick]] and published on [[Wizards.com]] on [[April 26]] [[2001]]. The article formed part of the ''[[Creature Feature]]'' series and provided roleplaying statistics for Cularin space slugs to feature in [[Wizards of the Coast]]s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Cularin Space Slug" /> The [[2003]] roleplaying adventure ''[[Who Goes Thaere?]]'' later depicted a juvenile space slug on the Cularin system [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Ostfrei]], though the adventure did not specify whether this space slug was of the Cularin variety.<ref name="Who Goes Thaere?">{{LivingForce|Who Goes Thaere?}}</ref>
